verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of choosing a storage region or residency. The privacy evidence covers only adjacent controls: deleting conversation history, opting out of model training, and browser actions running locally. None of these lets the user choose where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
